event: US Michigan consumer sentiment (final, Nov), Fri 20 Nov 17:00 SAST. Fed's Waller and Cook speak later Friday (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Worst week since March
bullets.text: Gold is down about 9% this week and traded near 3,525 this morning, its lowest since September 2025.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 97% odds of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 December, and Philly Fed's Paulson said rates need to rise again.

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.9, its strongest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is about 5.04%.

bullets.title: Forced selling
bullets.text: Analysts cite forced liquidation and trend-following funds selling, while stocks also fell about 2% on Thursday.

bullets.title: 3,500 in focus
bullets.text: FXEmpire watches 3,518 and the round 3,500; a daily close below opens about 3,421-3,475.

bullets.title: Quote times vary
bullets.text: This morning's quotes range from 3,525 to 3,558 and the 3,525 quote has no time stamp, so check your own chart first.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold of 3,500-3,518 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,500-3,518, only if it holds on a test

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
A test of 3,500-3,518 that slows and holds, with long lower wicks.
A 15M close back above 3,518 with a higher low.
The dollar and the 10-year yield easing back from their highs.
Take some profit at 3,525 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Catching a falling knife. Gold has fallen about 9% this week; wait for the hold.
A 1H close under 3,490 opens 3,475, then 3,421-3,447. Step aside.
The Michigan data at 17:00 SAST and Fed speakers can whip price both ways.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,570-3,590
look: A bounce back into 3,570-3,590 that stalls under the old support.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,570.
The dollar and the 10-year yield staying near their highs.
Take some profit at 3,550 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,525, right on support. Little room is left; wait for a bounce.
Gold is very oversold, and Friday short-covering can run fast. A 1H close above 3,602 opens 3,625-3,650.
Geopolitical or Fed headlines can spike gold in minutes. Do not chase news candles.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
